parts.name: Translation Panel 1
parts.Basic_description: This is a glass translation panel of the window, made of transparent glass material.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one of the sliding panes that can move horizontally to open or close the window.
parts.Movement_description: It can translate horizontally along the window frame to allow ventilation or closure.

parts.name: Translation Panel 2
parts.Basic_description: This is another glass translation panel of the window, made of transparent glass material.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as a movable pane that slides to overlap or uncover adjacent panels for opening or closing.
parts.Movement_description: It can translate horizontally within the track of the window frame.

parts.name: Translation Panel 3
parts.Basic_description: This is a third glass translation panel of the window, made of transparent glass material.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional coverage and can slide to adjust the window opening.
parts.Movement_description: It can move horizontally along the track to open or close the window partially.

parts.name: Translation Panel 4
parts.Basic_description: This is the fourth glass translation panel of the window, made of transparent glass material.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as one of the sliding panes that can be moved to regulate airflow and light.
parts.Movement_description: It can translate horizontally within the window frame track.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the window, made of aluminum, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds all the translation panels in place and provides the track for their movement.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and supports the sliding motion of the glass panels.
